items.title: Infleqtion: Losses Are Growing but So Is Its Crucial Federal Quantum Business.
items.summary: Infleqtion’s  second quarter numbers tell a familiar tech growth story: near-term losses continued to widen, even as demand for its array of quantum technologies push revenue higher.  Infleqtion ultimately reported a wider loss of 12 cents per share, though revenue beat projections at $12.6 million, a 116% jump from the prior year.  Widening losses are par for the course among early-stage quantum computing companies.
